correctness.rationale: The two graph couplings coincide algebraically at every vertex of degree 0 or 1. On K3 they differ only by the effective factor 2. The proper quartic potential and exact triangle Laplacian spectrum prove the global subcritical criterion. Every stationary coordinate solves one depressed cubic; root sums and the unique two-equal ratio root exhaust exactly thirteen points. Exact Hessian factors determine one index-two point, six index-one points and six minima; finite gradient omega limits and null saddle manifolds give the global almost-everywhere basin statement. Code residual and Hessian checks pass for seven strengths, but the infinite-parameter classification is analytical.
